svg.text: IFC Portfolio Explorer — data pipeline and database schema

Raw files are processed by the scripts in src/ into one DuckDB database (data/curated/ifc.duckdb). Solid boxes are tables, dashed boxes are views. Arrows join a PK or K column to the FK column of the next table.
